calibration_exposure.status: calibration-visible dynamic model-form freeze; execution-heldout outcome firewall remains closed

source_semantics_correction.source_statement: C, Si, and SiO2 refer to conditioning on the system chuck, a blank silicon wafer, and a blank silicon-dioxide wafer, respectively
source_semantics_correction.correction: the v5 symbol log_carbon_cycle_coefficient was semantically misnamed; its numeric feature was the logarithm of conditioning-repeat count, so the old fit arithmetic is unchanged while v6 names it conditioning-repeat count
experiment_sequence: declared conditioning sequence repeated 1, 3, or 9 times on chuck, blank Si, or blank SiO2
ten production Bosch wafers processed sequentially without intermediate cleaning and with one-minute inter-wafer breaks

model_form_discovery_record.interpretation: a between-wafer chamber state is missing, and an electrical impedance/sheath residual may remain after that state is modeled
model_form_discovery_record.selection_bias_disclosure: the dynamic model form was selected after examining calibration residuals and cannot be called pre-exposure blind

surface_laws_unchanged: La Magna/Garozzo C4F8 film and SiO2 removal

dynamic_state.name: incremental fluorocarbon wall occupancy relative to the declared post-conditioning state
dynamic_state.lot_initial_state: q_start=0 exactly after every declared conditioning sequence; this is a relative state definition, while the retained static lot-preparation multiplier represents the nonzero absolute post-conditioning wall response
dynamic_state.inter_wafer_transport: q_end from one production wafer is q_start for the next wafer in the same lot
dynamic_state.inter_wafer_break: q is held constant during the recorded one-minute plasma-off break because no wall-temperature or desorption diagnostic is available
dynamic_state.lot_boundary: q resets only at a declared conditioning sequence, never from wafer number, date, target depth, or a fitted per-lot value
dynamic_state.deposition_drive: D_C4F8 = integral of the measured C4F8-flow channel divided by the frozen calibration median
dynamic_state.cleaning_drive: D_SF6 = integral of the measured SF6-flow channel divided by the frozen calibration median
dynamic_state.rate_equation: dq/ds = k_dep*D_C4F8*(1-q) - k_clean*D_SF6*q over one normalized wafer interval
conservation_and_monotonicity: the analytic update preserves 0<=q_start,q_mean,q_end<=1 for nonnegative rates
with k_clean=0 and positive C4F8 dose, q cannot decrease
with k_dep=0 and positive SF6 dose, q cannot increase
the same recurrence is used in fitting, exact replay, and heldout prediction

physical_action.zero_dimensional_neutral_state: divide F and C4F8-film-precursor reference lifetimes by the combined wall-loss multiplier
physical_action.cylindrical_neutral_transfer: multiply upper and sidewall F and film-precursor loss velocities by the combined wall-loss multiplier

literature_topology_support.role: primary target-tool protocol explicitly designed to induce prior-chamber-state and within-lot process drift
independent primary fluorocarbon-ICP evidence that reactor-wall conditions alter fluorocarbon loss and etch behavior; no numeric rate is imported

free_parameters.bound_rationale: one reference wafer may change an unoccupied or occupied state by 0.1 percent to 95 percent before the competing process; the response remains inside the already frozen factor-four wall-loss interval

identifiability_gate.jacobian_unit: six fitted shared coefficients against calibration residual vector
identifiability_gate.bound_contact_rule: a dynamic coefficient within 0.1 percent of a bound fails identification unless a profile-likelihood interval closes inside the bound
identifiability_gate.failure_action: refuse the prediction seal and report the non-identifiable combination; do not choose a convenient rate or open heldout outcomes

calibration_and_selection.fit_scope: one shared six-coefficient law across calibration lots
calibration_and_selection.heldout_lot_dynamic_initialization: q=0 after its declared conditioning sequence, with no fitted heldout initial state
calibration_and_selection.objective: the frozen v5 aggregate residual vector, with mean Si depth, mean oxide loss, selectivity, and normalized radial shape scaled by their unchanged gates
required_before_heldout_reveal: all unchanged absolute calibration gates pass
aggregate whole-lot leave-one-out physics scores beat the global-mean depth baseline
aggregate whole-lot leave-one-out physics scores beat the shared mean-map point and normalized-shape baselines
the dynamic model improves the signed within-lot depth-slope error over v5
certification-grid refinement changes each acceptance observable by less than 0.25 of its frozen gate
code, data, parameter, fold-score, and heldout-prediction hashes are sealed

deterministic_acceleration.method: precompute exact species-resolved reactor-to-surface responses on fixed log wall-multiplier nodes, then use a shape-preserving differentiable one-dimensional interpolant
deterministic_acceleration.interpolation_validation: independent midpoint nodes not used to build the interpolant
deterministic_acceleration.final_fit_replay: all calibration and fold scores used for a seal must be recomputed through the exact reactor, cylindrical transfer, and surface path at the selected coefficients

forbidden_shortcuts: using wafer number, experiment key, lot number, date, or target depth as a model input
independent per-lot, per-wafer, or heldout initial wall states
additive or multiplicative corrections applied directly to predicted depth
changing Belen or La Magna/Garozzo surface coefficients
changing positive-ion energy, flux, or radial transfer in the dynamic-wall iteration
using heldout outcomes to choose recurrence signs, bounds, rates, interpolation nodes, or coefficients
weakening the v1 acceptance gates, empirical baselines, identifiability gate, or grid-refinement requirement
calling C a carbon-conditioning indicator; the source defines C as the bare system chuck
